title: Redwood June 2026 All-Hands / Leadership Update
summary: Monthly company all-hands. Samira reviewed company priorities (reliability, Private deployments, Dedicated growth), Ethan gave a runtime performance update and infra incidents recap, Maya presented product roadmap highlights (Optimize, rollouts, model catalog), Liam covered customer metrics and enterprise momentum. Q&A included questions about hiring, SOC2 timeline, and pricing. Meeting ended with action items and follow-ups.
action_items: Ethan - publish postmortem for May 28th infra incident by 2026-06-21
Maya - share updated Optimize beta signup sheet by 2026-06-19
Liam - package enterprise pitch deck and pricing tiers, share with sales by 2026-06-22

transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-06-17
Start time: 10:00 PDT
Duration: ~60 minutes
Attendees: Samira, Ethan, Maya, Liam, Noor, Diego, ~180 employees (Zoom)

Summary (auto): Company update, infra recap, product roadmap, customer momentum, hiring update, Q&A.

[00:00] Samira: Good morning, everyone, welcome to the June all-hands. Thanks for joining from everywhere. We'll run through a quick set of updates and then open for Q&A. I know it's a busy week so we'll try to keep to an hour.

[00:25] Ethan: Quick ask, can we get the slides up? I had one infra slide and one on cost.

[00:30] Samira: Yep, go ahead. Also big thank you to the on-call folks last week, appreciate the follow-through.

[00:45] Ethan: Alright, infra at a glance. May saw a spike in tail latency around low single-digit percentiles, caused by a cascade in the autoscaler when a subset of Dedicated pools failed a healthcheck. Root cause was a protobuf compatibility mismatch on our custom agent during an upgrade. We rolled forward a hotfix that restored KV cache warm up and autoscaler stability. I know the incident had some customer impact for two small Dedicated customers and some Hosted SLO blips.

[01:15] Ethan: Action taken: revert agent->stable, shipped a canary with the fixed proto, increased our canary window to 48 hours for critical infra agents. We're also adding more monitoring on the agent's handshake and a circuit-breaker for the autoscaler path.

[01:40] Samira: Thanks. What's the timeline for the postmortem?

[01:44] Ethan: We'll have a postmortem draft by Monday 2026-06-21, and a public summary for the affected customers same day.

[02:05] Maya: On product, a couple highlights. Optimize beta is now live to 25 customers; early signals show 12-18% token cost reduction for chat-heavy workloads with prefix caching and recommended batching. We're rolling out the model catalog UI update that lets customers pin quantized variants for Dedicated pools. Also starting a pilot for structured output templates tied to function calling.

[02:35] Maya: Note - some of the customers in the beta mentioned occasional hallucination regressions with a new quantized variant; we triaged and added a quality guard in the rollout so we can auto-fallback to full-precision variants when evals drop below threshold.

[02:55] Samira: Good, close the loop on those learning sets and make sure we have a regression alert. Also, status on Private deployments?

[03:05] Diego: Private is shipping two on-prem installs this quarter, one EU finance customer and one US healthcare pilot. We validated KMS integration and audit logs with their security teams. There were minor networking quirks with the V P C setup - some folks reported ambiguous routes - but the ops team helped get it sorted.

[03:30] Liam: From GTM, we saw an uptick in enterprise RFPs, especially around Dedicated capacity and compliance. SOC2 is ongoing - control mapping is in final review. We have three deals in late-stage procurement that are Dedicated-first and a pipeline of pilots for Private. Pricing questions keep coming up around predictable unit costs for mixed Hosted+Dedi routing; we'll publish a short FAQ for sales this week.

[04:00] Noor: Quick hiring update, we've opened roles for senior SREs and two product managers tied to Optimize and Private. Expect more outreach from recruiting.

[04:20] Audience (Q): What's the plan for latency improvements on longer sequence lengths?

[04:25] Ethan: We're optimizing the attention kernel selection and pre-compiling for common sequence buckets. Also experimenting with dynamic KV eviction policies to bound memory and reduce overhead for very long contexts. Early bench results show 8-10% lower 95th p90 for >8k context.

[04:50] Audience (Q): Any updates on SOC2 timeline?

[04:55] Liam: We're targeting a readiness review end of Q3, auditor selection next week. We'll share a customer-facing SOC2 readiness note soon.

[05:10] Audience (Q): Do we plan to change pricing for Optimize once it's GA?

[05:15] Maya: The plan is to have tiered pricing - a free optimizer config for small usage and a premium profile with SLA for higher-volume customers; pricing details will be shared with sales before GA.

[05:35] Samira: Ok let's talk metrics briefly - ARR motion is healthy, usage growth on Hosted continues but we see higher ACV expansion in Dedicated customers. Churn is low but watch renewal timing for three larger accounts that are up for renewal in August.

[05:55] Samira: Org update - Diego will lead the new inference-quality squad, focused on regressions, evals and deploy-time QA. Congrats Diego and team. Also ramping an on-call rotation for model rollout infra.

[06:15] Diego: Thanks. We'll be coordinating with Product and SRE to create reproducible evals that run in CI and gate rollouts.

[06:35] Samira: Ok time for a few lightning questions.

[06:40] Audience (Q): Are we expanding cloud regions?

[06:44] Ethan: Yes - planning APAC regions in Q4 with a partner cloud (region list to follow). For Dedicated we'll start with a small pool footprint to validate latency.

[07:05] Audience (Q): Any updates on partner channels?

[07:10] Noor: We signed a reseller agreement with a systems integrator in EMEA for Private deployments, contract announced next quarter.

[07:30] Samira: Wrapping up, a couple of asks - please fill out the hiring referral form if you know engineers, and keep the incident notes concise and paste links to postmortems in the all-hands thread.

[07:50] Samira: Recap of next steps: postmortem, Optimize beta outreach, SOC2 readiness note, hiring pipeline.

[08:05] Liam: I'll follow up with sales on the pricing FAQ and share it in the sales slack.

[08:20] Maya: I'll send the Optimize beta signup and a short list of feature toggles for early customers.

[08:35] Samira: Thanks everyone. Meeting adjourned.

Auto-generated action items (copied into notes): Ethan - PM postmortem; Maya - Optimize sheet; Liam - sales deck; Recruiting - open roles.

End of transcript.
